missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Президент' stays in the nominative case as the subject who spoke. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'сегодня' marks the time.

Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Президента' is the accusative direct object of 'выбрал', matching the genitive form because the noun is animate masculine. 'Нового' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Президента' is in the genitive case marking whose decision it is. The genitive links the noun to 'решение' as the source of the action.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Президенту' is in the dative case as the person addressed with the question. The dative marks the recipient of the inquiry.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Президентом' is in the instrumental case after 'с' to express meeting together. The construction is standard for a встреча between officials.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О президенте' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express what the papers write about. The phrase reports media coverage.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Президенты' is the nominative plural subject of 'встретились'. The sentence describes leaders gathering at a summit.

missions.phrase: Он стал президентом в прошлом году.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Президентом' is in the instrumental case after 'стал', which governs the instrumental of the new role. The phrase marks when he took office.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Президента' is the accusative object of 'слушают', taking the genitive form because the noun is animate. 'Внимательно' describes how they listen.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Президента' is genitive after 'у' in a possession frame describing his many tasks. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'дел'.
